visualCharacteristics: A centred full-width band with a white serif statement heading and body text that reveals on scroll. The purpose variant uses a solid blue band, the message variant a translucent navy band over the fixed hero video.
contentPattern: Row 1: an h2 heading (label text, optional em sub-label). Row 2: the statement body as an h3 and/or paragraphs.
usage: Use it to present a centred corporate purpose or message statement between recruitment page sections.
reuseGuidance: Reuse it for short centred statement bands; use default content or a hero when the text needs no band styling.
